# IStargateV2
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/interfaces/IStargateV2.sol)

**Title:**
IStargateV2

Interface for Stargate V2 Protocol

Based on LayerZero V2 OFT standard with Stargate extensions
